versions.changelog:
Initial release: Registers the "映客短视频" skill for summarizing and analyzing public short video and topic page data.

- Enables lightweight summaries and metric comparisons for publicly accessible short videos and topics.
- Supports keyword-based video aggregation, account performance comparisons, and ranking statistics.
- Focuses on manual triggering and avoids downloading, API calls, or batch crawling.
- Provides core data fields: video details, user profiles, and interaction metrics.
- Includes clear compliance guidelines: results for internal use only and respects platform restrictions.
